IC1: 1. Adult (males [OR] and females) aged 18 to 75 years (inclusive) [AND] with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH)
IC2: 2. A current diagnosis of symptomatic PAH classified by one of the following:
IC3: 1. Idiopathic (IPAH) [OR] or heritable pulmonary arterial hypertension (HPAH)
IC4: 2. PAH associated with one of the following connective tissue diseases (CTDs):
IC5: limited scleroderma, [OR] mixed connective tissue disease [OR] or overlap syndrome, [OR] or systemic lupus erythematosus
IC6: 3. PAH associated with anorexigen [OR] or methamphetamine use
IC7: 3. World Health Organization (WHO)/ [OR] New York Heart Association (NYHA) functional class II-IV symptomatology
